title: Build con-seams-pick

proofs.run: sh -c 'unset D WHOOSH_SOCKET_DIR WHOOSH_IPHONE_SOCKET_DIR ; python3 checks/seams/account-mark.py'
sh -c 'unset D WHOOSH_SOCKET_DIR WHOOSH_IPHONE_SOCKET_DIR ; python3 checks/seams/split-count.py'
sh -c 'unset D WHOOSH_SOCKET_DIR WHOOSH_IPHONE_SOCKET_DIR ; python3 checks/seams/decided-by.py'
with IPHONE_APP as above and MAC_APP=<built Mac Whoosh.app>: WHOOSH_RIG_HIDDEN=1 sh scripts/iphone-rig.sh --with-mac "$MAC_APP" "$IPHONE_APP" -- python3 checks/seams/account-mark.py
proofs.fail: [1-9][0-9]* failed|[1-9][0-9]* not judged|NOT JUDGED|REFUSED|NO SOCKET|NO INSTANCE|DIED|COULD-NOT-DRIVE

notes: Proofs 0-2 run the seam with no socket: seamlib.run (checks/seams/seamlib.py:215-257) prints 'PASS oracle all N labels green on the fixture-derived observation' when the judge passes the correct observation, then one row '| mutant | ... | RED: <label>: <detail> |' per mutant (or 'STAYED GREEN (judge blind to this defect)'), and the live-drive section prints 'NOT JUDGED live-drive no socket' (so the exit code is 1; the proof reads the lines, not the exit code). The runner must unset D and WHOOSH_SOCKET_DIR (the `sh -c 'unset ...'` does) so no app is driven. checks/seams/run.py:20-21 names the three as slice 'pick' (`--slice pick --mutants-only` runs the same). Proofs 3-5: the live drive under launch-one (hidden): per label 'PASS|FAIL|NOT JUDGED <label> <detail>' (seamlib.py:226-231) and the totals line; the pass regex demands 0 failed and 0 not judged, anchored at the end of the output. The mutants are app mutants (list row icon, reader header icon, decided_by on the row): each needs an app rebuild; their red lines name the surface label (list-row, reader-meta, decider@row; labels defined in account-mark.py:42-52 and decided-by.py docstring). The reader's 'red-on-mutant in the same output' is what proofs 0-2 print. | Round 2 (iphone-rig, 2026-11-12): the iOS 26.5 runtime is installed and scripts/iphone-rig.sh runs the phone with no window (docs/lanes/iphone-rig.md); the lead proofs below are the exact commands through it. IPHONE_APP and MAC_APP are the built .app bundles (the Mac one is the one launch-one.sh takes). Proofs 4 and 5 (split-count, decided-by) need the Mac rig only and are unchanged. The iPhone row of account-mark (labels icon@iphone-row, colour@iphone-row) is read from the phone row fields mark_icon and mark_colour (checks/seams/account-mark.py:58, InboxPhoneFeature.swift:76) through the rig in proof 3.
